stages.name: access_control
stages.note: Authorization and document ownership boundaries.

stages.name: adaptive_retrieval
stages.note: Evidence assessment, score-based context sizing, and bounded retrieval decisions.

stages.name: api
stages.note: Query request validation, defaults, and input limits.

stages.name: cache
stages.note: Cache replay, scope isolation, invalidation, and capacity behavior.

stages.name: chunking
stages.note: Text preservation, configured chunk bounds, and overlap behavior.

stages.name: citation_validation
stages.note: Evidence membership and authorization for cited sources.

stages.name: embedding
stages.note: Embedding shape, deterministic fallback, finiteness, and normalization.

stages.name: end_to_end
stages.note: A query through retrieval, prompt construction, generation contract, and output checks.

stages.name: generation
stages.note: Grounded response formatting, faithfulness scoring, and answer-length adaptation.

stages.name: hybrid_retrieval
stages.note: Dense and sparse retrieval fusion, access filtering, score ordering, and top-k bounds.

stages.name: ingestion
stages.note: Loader routing, unsupported formats, and extracted-text marker preservation.

stages.name: laya
stages.note: Laya decision delegation and deterministic fallback behavior.

stages.name: llm
stages.note: Provider request contracts and per-query output token budgets.

stages.name: memory
stages.note: Short-term turn limits and persistent session/message storage.

stages.name: presidio_pii
stages.note: PII detection before query data enters the RAG pipeline.

stages.name: prompt_injection
stages.note: Direct, indirect, obfuscated, and benign-lookalike input handling.

stages.name: query_expansion
